conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more limited upside potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5% monthly growth, prioritizing risk management. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding high-quality tech names. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a reasonable balance of risk and reward.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by stretching into leverage and concentration. It significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk.
